3SV_DIM_FISCAL_MONTH_01.@EndUserText.label: 3SV_DIM_FISCAL_MONTH_01
3SV_DIM_FISCAL_MONTH_01.@DataWarehouse.sqlEditor.query: WITH base AS ( SELECT "CalendarDate", "FiscalYearVariant", "FiscalYear", "FiscalPeriod", "FiscalYearPeriod", "FiscalPeriodStartDate", "FiscalPeriodEndDate" FROM "3GV_DIM_FISCALCALENDAR_01" WHERE "FiscalYearVariant" = 'V3' ), month_unique AS ( SELECT SUBSTRING("CalendarDate",1,6) AS "CALMONTH" FROM base GROUP BY SUBSTRING("CalendarDate",1,6) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "FiscalYearVariant") = 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT "FiscalYear") = 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT "FiscalPeriod") = 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT "FiscalYearPeriod") = 1 ), month_map AS ( SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTRING("CalendarDate",1,6) AS "CALMONTH", "FiscalYearVariant", "FiscalYear", "FiscalPeriod", "FiscalYearPeriod" FROM base ) SELECT m."CALMONTH", MIN(TO_DATE(b."CalendarDate", 'YYYYMMDD')) AS "CALMONTH_START_DATE", MAX(TO_DATE(b."CalendarDate", 'YYYYMMDD')) AS "CALMONTH_END_DATE", m."FiscalYearVariant" AS "FISCAL_YEAR_VARIANT", m."FiscalYear" AS "FISCAL_YEAR", m."FiscalPeriod" AS "FISCAL_PERIOD", m."FiscalYearPeriod" AS "FISCAL_YEAR_PERIOD", MIN(TO_DATE(b."FiscalPeriodStartDate", 'YYYYMMDD')) AS "FISCAL_PERIOD_START_DATE", MAX(TO_DATE(b."FiscalPeriodEndDate", 'YYYYMMDD')) AS "FISCAL_PERIOD_END_DATE" FROM base b JOIN month_unique u ON SUBSTRING(b."CalendarDate",1,6) = u."CALMONTH" JOIN month_map m ON m."CALMONTH" = u."CALMONTH" GROUP BY m."CALMONTH", m."FiscalYearVariant", m."FiscalYear", m."FiscalPeriod", m."FiscalYearPeriod"
